article.title: Russia Nears Final Preparations for New Strike on Ukraine’s Critical Infrastructure
article.summary: Zelensky says Russia is finalizing preparations for another massive strike on Ukraine, with energy, logistics, and essential infrastructure among the expected targets. He also called for more air defense interceptors and announced plans for new sanctions on Russia’s ballistic weapons industry.

article.title: Canadian Auto Factories Could Soon Build Weapons for Ukraine
article.summary: Canadian auto parts manufacturers and Ukraine’s defense industry have signed a memorandum on joint military production. The agreement could see Canadian factories manufacture drones, interceptors, unmanned ground vehicles and electronic warfare systems.

article.title: Nearly Half of Captured Foreign Recruits Knew They’d Fight Ukraine, Survey Says
article.summary: Nearly half of captured foreign recruits surveyed by Ukraine’s “I Want to Live” project said they knew before signing a Russian contract that they would fight. Only 1.7% said they were coerced or deceived into signing. Russian citizenship was the most cited motive.

article.title: Algeria condemns 'spillover' of Ukraine war into Libya
article.summary: Algeria on Thursday condemned what it called the ‘spillover’ of the war in Ukraine into Libya, after Kyiv’s attack on two Russian vessels off eastern Libya. Two Libyan soldiers were killed in Sunday’s drone strikes which sank a Russian warship and targeted a cargo ship in Libyan waters.

article.summary: France has defended Ukraine’s drone strikes on two Russian vessels off the Libyan coast. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said Ukraine was exercising its “absolute right to self-defense” against Russian aggression.

article.title: Italy Summons Ukrainian Military Envoy Over Libya Strikes
article.summary: Italy summoned Ukraine’s military attaché on Wednesday over Ukrainian strikes on Russian ships near Benghazi, Libya, according to Italian media. Ukraine’s ambassador accompanied him to the meeting. Rome is also considering stronger protection for about 200 Italian troops in Libya.

article.summary: Zelensky also expressed frustration over delays in American deliveries of Patriot air defense interceptors, saying Ukraine continued to face a severe shortage of missiles capable of stopping Russian ballistic attacks.

article.title: Stubb Doubts Year-End Peace, Urges Winter Aid for Ukraine
article.summary: Finnish President Alexander Stubb expressed doubt that Russia’s war against Ukraine would end before the end of 2026. In a Nov. 18 Bloomberg interview, he urged preparations for a difficult winter, prioritizing air defenses, energy infrastructure and financing.

article.title: Ukraine Prepares ‘Santa’ Mission to Bring Aid to Civilians Trapped on Occupied Kinburn Spit
article.summary: Ukraine’s military is preparing a humanitarian mission dubbed “Santa” to deliver food and medicine to civilians on the occupied Kinburn Spit. The initiative comes as Kyiv also identifies 15 settlements in Kherson and Zaporizhzhia regions for potential evacuation.
